item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 09/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong northeast monsoon will continue to bring cool and rainy weather to the coast of southern China tomorrow. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be showers and a chance of thunderstorms over southern China on Monday. With the upper-air disturbances departing, it will be mainly fine over the region on Tuesday. An easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.
